title: Composer Action Bar Usefulness Pass
principle: Every visible chat control must either do useful free work, open the exact next surface, or explain its zero-trust boundary.
public_repo_rule: This report stores only control labels, selectors and public-safe outcomes. It contains no prompts, responses, provider keys, pairing tokens, billing data or private telemetry.

controls.expected: Opens compact model picker and ensures the free local profile exists.
Private, Boost, MMIR++ and Vision toggle locally and show feedback.
Opens the same model picker as Add model.
Opens Node Dashboard for CPU/RAM, local model and node health.
Starts browser-local speech recognition or opens browser-local voice controls when unsupported.
Explains what the last composer action did without hiding cost, local or trust boundaries.
